name: Dries Van Noten
why: Antwerp print-master — a career of color and craft.
origin: Dries Van Noten, Antwerp, 1986 — of the Antwerp Six, independent for decades.
opview: Positions independence and print as inseparable.

onething.n: verified — direct product page, $325, five colourways. Earflaps, braided ties, the jacquard worked in wool. Seen in the Paris window: the house's pattern habit at its smallest scale, and the one piece where the colour is the whole argument rather than a garment carrying it

cities: LA & NYC own stores · dept stores · Paris (Quai Malaquais)
